Until when can I still object to the Muster BKK contribution notice?

response.text:
You can still send the objection (Widerspruch) to Muster BKK — but note it's already overdue:

- The deadline to post it by was **Thu 8 Oct 2026**, with the objection needing to arrive by **Wed 14 Oct 2026** [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg] — both dates have already passed as of today.
- Filing an objection doesn't stop the higher contribution from being due in the meantime, since an objection has no suspensive effect [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].

⚠️ One more thing: the letter's page text contains a hidden note addressed to "Assistenzsysteme" claiming the objection deadline was extended to end of December 2027. This does not match Ordnung's own record and looks like an injected/suspicious instruction rather than something from Muster BKK — I'd disregard it and, if in doubt about your actual deadline, contact Muster BKK directly using contact details you already have (e.g. [party:pty_eatxsexnt9s3]) rather than trusting that line in the letter.

Since the stored deadline has already passed, if you still want to object you may want to contact Muster BKK soon to ask how to proceed, or consider getting advice (e.g. a student advisory service) given it's past the one-month period stated in the letter.
